annotations.title: Add or subtract time from a date

description: Add or subtract years, months, weeks, days or business days from a date and return the resulting date and weekday. Month arithmetic clamps to the end of the month (31 January plus one month is the last day of February). Business days skip Saturdays and Sundays; public holidays are not known. Use negative numbers to go back in time.

business_days.description: Business days (Mon–Fri) to add, applied after everything else.
